changed_files.change_note: BIB-0027 re-issue, limited to the fields the change made stale. (1) palette_legend.dream_mucha_accents added (#C9A55A mucha_gold_leaf, #B7C4A4 faded_sage, #B9A9C6 faded_lilac, #D9B3AE pastel_rose, #E8DEC6 aged_ivory), sourced from style.json and used only as dream set-surface accents inside the haze, never in waking acts. (2) variants.dream: note now covers photoreal CGI integration and Mucha living in the sets, not the grade; new set_surface_accents block with the Hearts-set rule (only the gold stays, the pastels recede to trace level). The grade numbers are unchanged. variants.waking note: no Mucha accents and no stained-glass light. (3) New top-level scene_curves: stained-glass coloured light for SCN-long-hall (lilac/sage/ivory/gold), SCN-pool-of-tears (ivory-gold shaft with a lilac rim) and SCN-courtroom (gold and ivory only, as a Hearts set), plus hearts_sets (rose-tree yard, croquet-ground, courtroom). (4) Act-level stained_glass field on ep01 acts 3-6, ep02 act 1, ep05 act 3, ep08 acts 1-3 and ep09 acts 1-3. ep01 act 5 is 'None', so the p5-colorscript-fix-ep01 reflection_allowance stays the only light accent there and remains consistent. (5) CGI wording: ep04 act 6 'Cheshire Cat (performer doubling Dinah)' changed to a photoreal CGI cat whose coat echoes Dinah (matches world.json cp-cat.dream_rendering). Flamingo CRE-003 and hedgehog CRE-004 (derived_from, out_of_base, ep06 act 2), the puppy (ep03 act 4), the piglet end state (ep04 act 5) and the Footmen (ep04 act 4) now carry the photoreal CGI reading marked pending_H2. The Caterpillar (ep03 act 5) gets its CGI reading with the face design pending_H2. Also noted: the CGI Mouse and birds (ep02 act 1), the guinea-pig and animal jurors (ep08 act 2, ep09 act 1). (6) _meta: version, amendments[BIB-0027], inputs_read, constraints_honoured (CR-007 stained glass, CR-014 accents, CR-003/CR-015 lighting of CGI animals), user_refs.applied_to. (7) downstream_notes: grade-planner note (do not boost accents) and new lighting/environment and creature/appearance notes. Unchanged: every existing hex in palettes and key_palettes, act numbering, event_refs, scene_ids, variant tags and grade numbers, peaks, and the out_of_base countersign asks. No dialogue or story events touched.
